materialCorrections: The first stack-growth fixture lacked initialized spare registration space; its original ownership failure is retained and excluded. Corrected admitted vector size10/capacity16 provides real initialized spare storage.

The captured-outer allocator initially expected exact element count instead of actual reserve capacity4; its rejected original run is retained, and the provider contract now follows measured allocation sizes.

A same-final-heap constructor cleanup-order control initially escaped a multiset-only ownership check; exact temporary disposal order and NULL-versus-inactive current-frame observations were added. The completed qualification rejects that control on all three authored targets.
Intermediate producer freshness guards rejected changing inputs during development. Only complete runs whose input hashes remain stable qualify.

A synthetic Windows control initially required an unavailable stack-probe runtime because its observation buffer was automatic storage; moving that fixture-only buffer to static storage made the selected controls normally return.
